name: NGP
fix_description: Root cause is incorrect operation ordering in _update: fee deduction from pair + sync() happens BEFORE the user transfer completes, creating an inconsistent intermediate state where pair reserves are already modified but the sell has not finalized. This is similar to a state-mutation-before-interaction pattern (akin to reentrancy). Fix: move all fee deductions and sync() to AFTER super._update(from, to, value) completes. Additionally, replace getPrice() spot reserve ratio with TWAP oracle, and remove DEAD from whitelist.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a short multi-step DeFi exploit involving a flashloan, fee-on-transfer swap routing, and understanding a token-specific sync/_update bug that manipulates the pair price. While the execution path is only a few calls, identifying the required precomputed amounts and why sending bought tokens to the dead address distorts reserves requires protocol-specific reasoning beyond an obvious pattern.
